typography.strategy: Use 'Cairo' (font-weight: 700/900) with tracking-tight for totals, headings, and scores. Use 'Tajawal' (font-weight: 400/500) for player names and UI labels. Numbers must strictly remain LTR (dir='ltr') even within RTL layout to ensure proper readable digit format (e.g. '-30' instead of '30-').

colors.strategy: Archetype: Luxury (Dark) and Swiss High-Contrast (Light). Use 'Primary/Gold' for highlighting the winning player (lowest score) and 'Danger/Red' for the losing player (closest to threshold). Avoid pure black/white to maintain an elegant, premium casino-like vibe.

layouts.rtl_guidelines: Ensure the main container or html tag uses `dir="rtl"`. Reverse all directional icons. Text is right-aligned (`text-right`). Do not use symmetrical margins; use Tailwind logical properties (`ms-`, `me-`, `ps-`, `pe-`).
layouts.scoreboard_grid: Horizontal scrolling table container (`overflow-x-auto`) to support 4-8 players without squishing. Sticky top header for Player Names & Totals. Dense padding (`p-2` or `p-3`). Highlight Logic: Apply a subtle background tint (`bg-primary/10`) and a top/bottom border (`border-primary`) for the leader's column. Apply `bg-danger/10` to the loser's column.
layouts.modal_quick_add: Grid of large, tap-friendly chips (2 columns, 3 rows) for standard inputs [-30, -60, 25, 100, 125, 200]. Min height `h-14` or `h-16` for mobile touch targets.

components.player_setup: Dynamic list of players with an elegant 'Add Player' input. Use a clear 'X' icon or swipe-to-delete for removal. Segmented control or radio group for Threshold (700 or 1000).
components.score_entry: Mobile-friendly Bottom Drawer or centered Modal. Contains the selected player's name prominently, quick-add chips, and a custom number input field. Include a large submit button.
components.round_history: Rows within the grid showing historical scores. Add a sticky 'Undo Last Round' button at the bottom of the scoreboard or as a Floating Action Button (FAB).
components.theme_toggle: A crisp, tactile switch or icon button in the top navigation bar to toggle between Light and Dark mode.

motion.strategy: Snappy and tactile. Use subtle scaling (`active:scale-95`) on buttons and chips to simulate physical touch. Use framer-motion or CSS transitions for Drawer slide-up and list item removal.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over gold/red highlights remains high-contrast.
accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 48x48px for all mobile tap targets, especially the quick-add score chips.

background_empty_state.description: Person holding golden playing cards. Use at very low opacity (5-10%) in the background of the setup screen or empty states to reinforce the premium card game theme.

hero_accent.description: Elegant focus on playing cards. Can be used for a splash screen or decorative top header.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build as a mobile-first React web app using React JS (.js/.jsx files) and Tailwind CSS.
Implement a robust `localStorage` utility (via Custom Hook or Context) to persist game state (players, rounds history, threshold) preventing accidental data loss.
Include 'Cairo' and 'Tajawal' from Google Fonts and configure them in `tailwind.config.js`.
Ensure RTL is implemented perfectly. Arabic UI requires `dir="rtl"`, but mathematical score blocks MUST use `dir="ltr"` inside them so negatives render properly (e.g. '-30').
Calculate Highlights Dynamically: Compute totals array -> find min (leader) -> apply Gold accent classes. Find max (loser) -> apply Red accent classes.
Use Shadcn components where applicable, but rely on raw Tailwind for the complex, horizontally scrolling mobile grid layout.
Never use `transition: all`. Target specific properties for animations.
Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, chips) for testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use 2-3x more spacing where possible. Cramped designs look cheap.
Avoid generic centered layouts; prioritize optical alignment.
NEVER use complete transparent background in header or overlays.
Use modern button styles (pill-shaped or slightly rounded) with interaction animations.
Use `sonner` for toast notifications (e.g. 'Round undone', 'Game reset').
Ensure the app container is NOT center-aligned via `.App { text-align: center; }`.
